record.field: Strengthen, sculpt and realign your body with our Tone Membership. Designed for those who love the precision of Pilates, it gives you unlimited access to all our Pilates Reformer and mat classes. Build core strength, improve your posture and gain flexibility under the guidance of our certified instructors, at your own pace and on your own schedule. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced practitioner, it is the ideal way to make Pilates a lasting part of your routine.

Commit to your practice and elevate your well-being with our Unlimited Membership. Built for dedicated practitioners and those seeking a consistent routine, this pass unlocks unlimited daily access to all our in-studio classes and workshops. Enjoy complete freedom over your schedule, priority booking during peak hours, and exclusive discounts on special weekend events. It is more than just a membership—it is your key to a thriving, balanced lifestyle within a supportive community.
A flexible pass for 5 yoga or Pilates sessions, valid for 6 months. Choose from Vinyasa, Hatha, or Pilates classes, perfect for all levels.

A tailored yoga experience for private groups of 15 or more. Perfect for corporate teams, wellness retreats, or special events, this session is customized to your group's needs and skill levels. Choose from Vinyasa, Hatha, or Restorative yoga styles.

Are you ready to step beyond the physical and experience yoga in its absolute fullness? Welcome to The Ultimate Dimension, an immersive workshop designed to elevate your practice, quiet your mind, and unlock the boundless potential within you.

Yoga is far more than physical postures; it is a gateway to a deeper state of consciousness. In this unique masterclass, we will journey beyond the boundaries of the everyday hustle to explore the ultimate dimension of your true self. Through a powerful blend of breath, movement, and stillness, you will learn to align your body, connect with your inner energy, and access a profound sense of peace.
